audits.text:
## 8cbd834f4187

**AUD-8CBD-ROTATED-SORTED-COLOR-AMBIGUITY — Reproduced query-rotation defect; ordinary fixed-order production remains distinguished in the tested scope.**

Audited generator SHA-256 `73580661c53ffee7ecf3987f1e76fda85626b3fa931a6c2832ff5a37c06aab5f`; executed canonical Racket rule hash `4db26130eaff`.

For `difficulty=easy`, `seed=1`, consecutive sample indices `7..12`, the six visible seed sequences are:

`[2,4]`, `[3,6]`, `[1,4,8]`, `[9,5,2]`, `[1,5]`, `[1,3]`.

Hold out pair index 3 (`sample_index=10`) as the query. Every one of the remaining five demonstrations already has ascending seed colors, so the rival **“sort the seed colors before cycling them at triangular columns”** fits all five. On the held-out descending sequence `[9,5,2]`, that rival sorts to `[2,5,9]` and disagrees with the public Racket answer. All six inputs pass the current validator; `checks/audit/8cbd834f4187/witness.json` retains the exact query, Racket output, rival output, demo indices and hashes.

This is specifically a rotation limitation. In the ordinary last-pair-query ordering for the same six-pair window, the descending pair remains demonstration index 3 and refutes the rival. A source-bound Python mirror scan of **30,000** ordinary fixed-order lessons (3 bands × 500 seeds × 20 starts) found no declared-competitor ambiguity; see `checks/audit/8cbd834f4187/fixed-order-scan.json`. That scan is not a Racket authority run; the exact rotated witness is Racket-checked.

The combined audit also found that the retained task test is not portable because it guesses a canonical path with fixed `__file__.parents[...]`; preflight recommends `reviewer_support.find_root/canonical_pairs` (`checks/audit/8cbd834f4187-combined/result.json`).

Suggested repair if arbitrary query rotation is supported downstream: force at least two non-ascending color-order demonstrations per six-pair window, or use a schedule whose witness survives every one-pair holdout, and expose the sorted-color competitor publicly. If production always fixes the last pair as query, document that ordering limitation explicitly. Audit only; source left unchanged.

Evidence: `checks/audit/8cbd834f4187/input.json`, `probe-pre-racket.json`, `racket.json`, `witness.json`, `fixed-order-scan.json`, and the combined audit report.
